name: VO2max 4 × 4
description: The Norwegian 4 × 4: 4 min at 112 % of FTP, 3 min easy at 60 %, four times, after a 15-minute warm-up with an opener.
protocol_source: Helgerud et al. 2007, Med Sci Sports Exerc 39:665 (ICD RD-21): 4 × 4 min at 90–95 % of HRmax with 3 min active recovery at 70 % of HRmax; 112 % of FTP (Coggan's level 5, 106–120 %, RD-19) and 60 % are design
